claim: Both builds import the same 97 undefined dynamic symbols: 94 via R_ARM_JUMP_SLOT, __sF and __stack_chk_guard via R_ARM_GLOB_DAT, and __cxa_call_unexpected / __gnu_Unwind_Find_exidx additionally via R_ARM_ABS32 in .text literal pools.
observation: readelf --dyn-syms: 98 UND entries incl. the null symbol; identical name/bind sets in v5; 4 weak (__cxa_begin_cleanup, __cxa_call_unexpected, __cxa_type_match, __gnu_Unwind_Find_exidx).
interpretation: The platform boundary is identical for both builds; the port must re-provide libc/libm/GLES1/C++ runtime equivalents for exactly this set.

claim: PLT stub -> import mapping is established by decoding every stub: PLT0 is 20 bytes, then 94 stubs of 12 bytes (add ip,pc,#X; add ip,ip,#Y; ldr pc,[ip,#Z]!), each loading the GOT slot named by the matching .rel.plt entry.
observation: import_census.py asserts stub GOT slot == R_ARM_JUMP_SLOT offset for all 94 stubs in both builds (v5 uses non-canonical rotated immediates, decoded from raw bits).
interpretation: Call-site attribution to import names is exact.

claim: There are 614 direct B/BL call sites to imports in each build; no import is used as a function pointer.
observation: Scanned $a-mapped .text only. No relocated data word and no PC-relative address formation equals a PLT stub; v5 literal words at v5:0x809bc and v5:0x80114 equal stub addresses numerically but carry no relocation.
interpretation: Every import is reached by direct calls whose callers are listed; the platform layer can be replaced function by function.

claim: Both builds contain DT_TEXTREL caused by 12 relocations in .text literal pools of the statically linked libgcc EHABI unwinder.
observation: readelf -d shows TEXTREL; relocation offsets fall inside .text.
interpretation: Modern Android rejects text relocations (targetSdk>=23); irrelevant to the port except that the checker forbids it (rule E4).

claim: DT_NEEDED is libc.so, libstdc++.so, libm.so, libGLESv1_CM.so, libdl.so, liblog.so; no symbol is imported from libdl or liblog.
observation: readelf -d; import names checked against categories.
interpretation: The port links libc/libm/GLESv1_CM (+log/android for its own bridge).

claim: Neither build contains Thumb code.
observation: 0 $t mapping symbols (v7a: 1261 $a / 849 $d), no odd function symbol addresses, no BLX <imm>; BLX <reg> only in libgcc unwinder v7a:0x7f18c, 0x7f778, 0x7f890.
interpretation: Pure ARM state; no interworking concerns; the Unicorn harness can run ARM mode only.

claim: Build attributes: v7a Tag_CPU_arch v7, Tag_FP_arch VFPv2, no Tag_ABI_VFP_args (base/softfp PCS); v5 v5TE without FP; both wchar_t 4, enum_size int, align_needed 8-byte, FP_denormal Needed, FP_number_model IEEE 754.
observation: readelf -A output.
interpretation: ABI facts used in docs/ABI_PORTING.md sections 3-7, 10.

claim: GL census: 283 GL call sites in 45 imported GLES 1.x functions (same counts in v5); 440 arguments resolve to constants, 185 are runtime values.
observation: gl_census.py constant propagation per function (r0-r3 and outgoing stack slots, softfp float bit patterns).
interpretation: Fixed-function state inventory in docs/PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES.md section 3.1.
next_step: Resolve runtime args (sizes/pointers) with the native-analysis area if needed

claim: InitGL sets up: shared static element buffer of 3072 bytes (1536 u16 indices of degenerate-joined quads), glEnable(GL_DITHER), glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE), glShadeModel(GL_FLAT), glClearColor(0,0,0,0), glClearDepthf(1), glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST), glDepthFunc(GL_LEQUAL), glDepthRangef(0,1), two glHint(...,GL_FASTEST), glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST), glColor4f(1,1,1,1).
observation: Manual disassembly matches gl_usage.json constants (e.g. movw r0,#0x809d at 0x7ac48; mov r0,#3024 = 0xBD0 at 0x7ac40).
interpretation: Initial GL state the port must reproduce after every context (re)creation (nativeReInit calls InitGL at 0x155fc).

claim: G0SetBlend(int) maps modes 0-9 via a jump table to: 0 blend off + depth write on; 1,2,5,7 (SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); 3 (ONE,ONE); 4,6 (SRC_ALPHA, SRC_COLOR); 8 (ZERO, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); 9 (ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); all blending modes enable GL_BLEND and set glDepthMask(GL_FALSE).
observation: Jump table entries 0x7b720-0x7b744; state cached in gG0BlendMode.
interpretation: Complete blend-mode table for the renderer reconstruction.

claim: Fog is enabled with glFogfv(GL_FOG_COLOR, (*ptr)+20), glFogf(GL_FOG_DENSITY, 0.02f) and glHint(GL_FOG_HINT, GL_DONT_CARE); GL_FOG_MODE is never set.
observation: Only one glFogf call exists (pname 0xB62) and one glFogfv (pname 0xB66).
interpretation: The ES 1.x default fog mode GL_EXP applies (spec default); START/END unused.

claim: Vertex data formats: position 3xGL_FLOAT stride 20 or 3xGL_SHORT stride 10; texcoords 2xGL_FLOAT stride 20 or 2xGL_SHORT stride 10; short positions are scaled with glScalef(1/128).
location: gl_usage.json glVertexPointer/glTexCoordPointer sites; glScalef at v7a:0x7cae8, 0x7cde8
observation: Constant size/type/stride args recovered; some strides runtime.
interpretation: Interleaved xyz+uv vertex layouts; GL_TEXTURE matrix (6 glMatrixMode sites) is used for UV scaling.
next_step: Confirm the short-format path end-to-end with the native-analysis area

claim: glDepthRangef is called with (0,1), (-0.004,0.996) and (-1,1).
observation: Constant float bit patterns recovered (0xbb83126f etc.).
interpretation: GLES clamps both values to [0,1]; the toon outline pass relies on an offset depth range.

claim: No colour/normal array, lighting, material, alpha-func, multitexture, mipmap or compressed-texture entry points are imported; GL_ALPHA_TEST is only disabled and GL_COLOR_ARRAY only disabled once.
observation: 45 GL imports enumerated.
interpretation: Per-draw colour is constant (glColor4f); lighting is not fixed-function. Does not imply the look is unlit (textures/CPU may bake shading).

claim: The Java view never calls setEGLContextClientVersion, so GLSurfaceView creates its default OpenGL ES 1.x context; the manifest declares glEsVersion 0x00010001.
observation: jadx/smali show setRenderer only.
interpretation: The port keeps an ES 1.x context for now.

claim: The native code resolves 26 Java callbacks by name/signature from table gJAVAFunction (26 x {jmethodID, char* name, char* sig}).
observation: Names/signatures listed in docs/PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES.md section 2.
interpretation: The port's ADRenderer must keep these 26 public methods (checked by check_shell_parity.py).

claim: JAVA_RegisterFunctions stores the JNIEnv*, the ADRenderer jobject (local reference) and its GetObjectClass result (local reference) in globals gJavaEnv/gJavaObj/gJavaClass without NewGlobalRef.
location: v7a:0x13ca4-0x13d10 (str r4,[r2] 0x13ce8; str r8,[r12] 0x13cec; GetObjectClass via [r3,#0x7c] 0x13cf4; str r0,[r3] 0x13d10)
observation: No NewGlobalRef (+0x54) call in the function.
interpretation: Using the cached local reference from later native calls is invalid JNI (tolerated by pre-ICS Dalvik); the port must use global refs.

claim: JNIDatInit reads FileDescriptor.descriptor via FindClass/NewGlobalRef/GetFieldID/GetIntField, dup()s it, fdopen(fd,"rb")s it, reads a 244-byte header and the directory, and converts each 24-byte directory record's field +4 from an offset into an absolute 32-bit pointer.
interpretation: In-place pointer fix-up in a 32-bit slot: must become offset-based on AArch64.

claim: JNIDatInit calls DeleteLocalRef on the reference returned by NewGlobalRef.
location: v7a:0x1528c (NewGlobalRef, result saved at [sp,#4]), v7a:0x1543c (DeleteLocalRef of [sp,#4])
observation: Two calls through JNIEnv+0x5c at the end of the function.
interpretation: JNI misuse; effect on modern ART CheckJNI unknown.
next_step: Port must not replicate; JNI owner to confirm

claim: Sound effects go through RShellSoundPlay/RShellVoicePlay -> PfmAudioPlaySample -> JAVAPlaySample with volume = vol * PfmNormalizeSfx|Voice * PfmSampleVolume (all initially 1.0); pan/pitch arguments are dropped; stop calls map to SoundPool.stop.
observation: Disassembly; float initial values read from .data.
interpretation: Audio boundary is a thin Java wrapper; pan is never implemented.

claim: Music: RShellMusicPlay ignores repeated names and calls JAVAPlayMusic; constant names seen are 'mainmenu' (6 callers) and 'introtext'; 'music1'-'music4' strings exist; 58 of 170 .ogg basenames exist as strings, 52 referenced from gSFXBank.
location: v7a:0x1a688; callers via callsite_args.py; strings v7a:0x82f58, 0x83834, 0x83f00-0x83f18; gSFXBank 0x8bacc
observation: callsite_args.py output; string search in the ELF.
interpretation: The remaining 112 .ogg names (voice lines) are not in the binary.
next_step: Assets/native areas: confirm voice names come from cRVoiceManager::Init data (hypothesis)

claim: JNIMouseEvent scales x by 640/gG0DeviceScreenWidth and y by 480/gG0DeviceScreenHeight, is gated by gGameValid, and maps action 0 to ClickiPhone(true)+ClickOn, action 1 to ClickiPhone (only when Game state word +0x718fc == 2)+ClickOn, other actions to ClickOff.
observation: Constants 0x44200000 (640.0) and 0x43f00000 (480.0) at 0x14410/0x14414; mouse object *Game+552.
interpretation: Virtual 640x480 input space.

claim: JNIKey converts Android key codes: A-Z -> ConvertCode(lower-case ASCII), 0-9 -> ConvertCode(ASCII digit), SPACE->57, ENTER->28, DEL->14 (DirectInput scan codes), delivered to KeySet only when *(Game)+0xbf0 == 2.
observation: add r2,r2,#68 / #41; mov r4,#57/#28/#14; uxtb before bl cKeyPad::ConvertCode(char) at 0x13ddc/0x13de8.
interpretation: Keyboard path inherited from a DirectX/PC code base.

claim: JNIAccelerometer forwards (x,y,z) to cAccelerometer::Input(*Game + 3028, x, y, z) when Game is non-null; Java low-pass filters and negates x/y.
interpretation: Sensor boundary is a single call.

claim: nativeResize stores (float)w into gG0DeviceScreenWidth and gG0ScreenWidth and (float)h into gG0DeviceScreenHeight and gG0ScreenHeight.
observation: vcvt.f32.s32 + vstr to four GOT-resolved globals.
interpretation: Screen-size boundary.

claim: The game clock is System.nanoTime(): native JAVATime() combines JAVATime (low) and JAVATimeHi (high) and divides the unsigned 64-bit value by 1000 (microseconds); GetTime() tail-calls it; callers appRender, cRLoadingBar::ScriptAI (3), cRResourceManager::AI (2).
observation: CallIntMethod with gJAVAFunction+0x114/+0x120, bl __aeabi_uldivmod with r2=1000.
interpretation: Monotonic microsecond clock; port can use clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) only if the Java shell semantics are kept equivalent.

claim: appRender runs fixed 16666 us logic steps (FontAI + cRGame::AI) against gTimeLast, up to four per rendered frame, resynchronising when further behind, then G0Render().
observation: Branch structure read manually.
interpretation: Fixed-step game loop; frame delta is not passed to AI.
next_step: Native-analysis area to confirm exact catch-up rules

claim: gettimeofday is called only in _getTime(), whose only callers are in nativePause, which the Java code never invokes.
location: v7a:0x154d0 (call), 0x15530/0x15548 (callers); smali ADGLSurfaceView.smali declares nativePause without invoke
observation: import census + callsite_args + smali grep.
interpretation: Wall-clock time does not reach game logic in the shipped app.

claim: Persistent files are written through JAVASaveFile as raw memory: 'asm.cfg' = gConfig (0x130 bytes), 'of.cfg' = gOFOData (0x2d00 bytes), 'RandTable.bin' = gRMathRand2Table (0x3ffe bytes), plus hs_%08i.bin/tt_%03i.bin and text-format high scores.
observation: callsite_args.py shows constant name, buffer and size arguments.
interpretation: Save formats are C struct memory images: layout is part of the file format.

claim: All fopen/chdir/getcwd/exit/printf/putchar/fprintf/fputc call sites are in functions with no direct caller, no relocated pointer and no PC-relative address formation.
location: RShellGetFileSize(char*) 0x1bbc0, RShellDatInit 0x1c018, RShellChangeDir 0x1c138, RShellPushDir/PopDir, RShellStop 0x1b6ac, gRegisterInit 0x217ec, gRegisterFindFile, gRegisterGetFileSize(char*), gRegisterMakeKeyEmail, cRSubTracks::Export 0x74a98, cRDirectX::Export
observation: callsite_args.py caller search; RELATIVE-relocation targets; ConstProp search for add rX,pc,rY forming function addresses (0 found).
interpretation: These paths are unreachable in the shipped game.
next_step: Treat as dead unless the native-analysis area finds an indirect caller

claim: Game randomness is table driven: Rand() returns gRMathRand2Table[(idx+1) mod 8191] & 0x7fff; the table is filled once from (uint16_t)lrand48() and saved as RandTable.bin, loaded on later runs; lrand48 is called nowhere else except dead gRegisterInit.
location: Rand v7a:0x167f0; gRMathRand2Init v7a:0x195d0-0x19674; string 'RandTable.bin' v7a:0x811dc; lrand48 sites 0x19610, 0x217f8, 0x2187c
observation: Disassembly and import census.
interpretation: Determinism depends on the persisted table and seeds; srand48 has no later effect.

claim: glibc lrand48 after srand48 matches the explicit POSIX LCG (a=0x5DEECE66D, c=0xB) for 7 seeds x 100000 draws on x86-64, AArch64 (qemu) and ARMv7 (qemu); unseeded glibc starts from X=0 (first value 0) whereas the BSD default state 0x1234ABCD330E gives 851401618.
observation: Recorded run 2026-09-27; predicted first-run table FNV-1a 0xb001bee8.
interpretation: Seeded behaviour is portable; the unseeded default (used by the first-run table) is libc-specific.
next_step: Q1: confirm bionic-2011 default state from a device RandTable.bin

claim: Native wprintf(char*, ...) is an empty function and JNIDebug returns 0, so neither native nor Java debug text is printed; RShellPrintText/Warning/Error vsprintf into a 4096-byte stack buffer.
observation: push {r0-r3}; add sp,sp,#16; bx lr / mov r0,#0; bx lr.
interpretation: Debug output is compiled out; vsprintf buffer can overflow.

claim: v7a game code uses 24193 VFP instructions: 711 VMLA, 38 VMLS, 66 VNMLS, 13 VNMUL, 362 VDIV, 3 VSQRT, 840 VCVT, 865 VMRS APSR_nzcv flag transfers; no fused MAC, no VMSR, no VMRS to a core register, no NEON, no VFPv3-only encodings, no D16-D31 outside libgcc.
observation: capstone census over $a ranges split into game/runtime by symbol name.
interpretation: Scalar VFPv2 code only; FPSCR never changed by the app.

claim: The original tVector::Dot evaluates its VMLA chain with two roundings, and AArch64 GCC (gnu default) and clang contract the equivalent C to FMADD producing a different result unless -ffp-contract=off.
observation: Unicorn: 0.0 for a=(1+2^-23,1+2^-23,0), b=(1-2^-23,-(1-2^-23),0); fused model -1.42e-14; aarch64 gcc default +1.42e-14, clang default -1.42e-14, -ffp-contract=off 0.0.
interpretation: -ffp-contract=off is mandatory for reconstructed code.
contradictions: Unicorn uses QEMU's implementation of the ARM ARM, not silicon; matches the architecture specification

claim: Float-to-int conversions saturate with NaN->0 in both builds; tColourSmall::Set stores (uint8_t)(uint32_t)(x*255) so 1.2->50, 2.0->254, -0.1->0, NaN->0, 1e10->255.
observation: unicorn_runtime_probe.py [2],[3]; f2i_check shows x86 raw casts differ for 7/12 inputs, AArch64/ARMv7 for 0.
interpretation: Reconstructed code needs ARM-semantics conversion helpers.

claim: libgcc integer division in the original returns quotient 0 for division by zero (remainder = dividend) and INT_MIN for INT_MIN/-1, without trapping.
observation: unicorn_runtime_probe.py [4].
interpretation: C code must not rely on UB; explicit helpers where the divisor may be 0.

claim: Game code never uses signed byte loads or sign-extending byte instructions, and callers zero-extend plain char arguments.
location: abi_audit.py (v7a ldrsb 0, sxtb 0, ldrb 939, uxtb 79; v5 ldrsb 0, ldrb 948); v7a:0x13ddc
observation: uxtb r1,r2 before bl cKeyPad::ConvertCode(char).
interpretation: Plain char is unsigned (ARM EABI); host tests need -funsigned-char.

claim: No TLS, atomics, barriers or system calls: no PT_TLS/.tdata/.tbss/TLS relocations/CP15 c13 reads, no LDREX/STREX/SWP/DMB/DSB/ISB, no SVC/BKPT/UDF; coprocessor LDC2/STC2 only in libgcc iWMMXt helpers.
observation: Census output.
interpretation: Nothing platform-specific at the instruction level beyond scalar VFP.

claim: The library neither throws nor catches C++ exceptions and has no RTTI; .ARM.exidx has 1151 entries (v7a 962 inline, 173 extab, 16 CANTUNWIND).
observation: No __cxa_throw/__cxa_allocate_exception/__cxa_begin_catch imported or defined; no _ZTI/_ZTS symbols; vtables have a zero typeinfo slot.
interpretation: -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti are acceptable for reconstruction.

claim: JNIOFOSubmitCB and JNIOFOUnlockCB treat their Java int argument as a byte pointer and write 2 through it when non-zero, then set a global flag byte to 1.
observation: cmp r5,#0; movne r3,#2; strbne r3,[r5].
interpretation: A native pointer round-trips through a Java int (CBOFOStatePtr): impossible to keep on AArch64 without a handle table.

claim: Code pointers exist only in 42 vtables (one virtual function each), 11 .init_array constructors and 3 GOT entries (ObjectProcVertexCompare, DatHashGetString, TexturesFunctionGetName).
observation: All R_ARM_RELATIVE targets inside .text enumerated (plus 8 in the libgcc unwinder).
interpretation: Static-init order is link order Ad, RMaths, RShell, RObject, Font, RSprite, Game, SubGame, Voice, LoadingBar, GL.

claim: qsort is called twice with 4 elements of 4 bytes and comparator ObjectProcVertexCompare returning *a - *b.
observation: mov r1,#4; mov r2,r1; comparator via GOT 0x8b128; rsb r0,r0,r3.
interpretation: Instability irrelevant (plain ints); wrap-around subtraction must be preserved.

claim: Register-controlled shifts in reachable game code occur at RShellBlankTga 0x1a3b0 and cRSpriteManager::New 0x2deac (flags |= 1 << n); cRSubGame::AI 0x730f4 shifts by a constant 6.
observation: abi_audit.py sites.
interpretation: ARM (amount & 0xff) vs AArch64 (amount mod 32) semantics differ for amounts >= 32.
next_step: Native area: bound the shift amounts

claim: _getTime computes tv_sec*1000 + tv_usec/1000 in 32-bit arithmetic (mla) so the value wraps modulo 2^32.
observation: smull by 0x10624dd3 (/1000), mla r0,r0,r2,r3 with r0=1000.
interpretation: time_t/long widening on AArch64 would change the value; use uint32_t explicitly (path unreachable in the shipped app).

claim: Floats passed to JNI Call*Method varargs are promoted to double.
observation: vcvt.f64.f32 d7,s13; vstr d7,[sp] before CallIntMethod/CallVoidMethod.
interpretation: Normal C varargs rule; relevant only for hand-built jvalue arrays.

claim: libm calls: double sin/cos (RMathInit table build), acos, atan, exp, pow, sqrt (from float wrappers), floor (double), floorf and tanf (float); the RMathSin/RMathCos float tables are insensitive to +-2 ulp double libm differences (0 of 32768 entries each).
observation: trig_table_sensitivity.py with host libm as reference.
interpretation: libm choice cannot change the trig tables; other functions may differ by <=1 ulp.

claim: RandSeed(s) stores s % 8191 (truncating signed remainder) as a u16 index and calls srand48(s); Rand() increments the u16 index and reduces it with an unsigned mod 8191.
observation: Magic-number division sequences decoded.
interpretation: Index arithmetic signedness must be kept exactly.

claim: Pointer-bearing tables in .data: gSFXBank uses 12-byte records whose first word is a relocated char*; gJAVAFunction uses 12-byte {jmethodID, char*, char*} records.
observation: Relocation targets are sample-name strings in .rodata.
interpretation: Record sizes change on AArch64; reconstructed code must index symbolically.

claim: nativePause, nativeDone and SnailMailApplication.JNIOFInit are never invoked from Java; JNIOFInit has no native implementation in either build.
observation: grep for invoke of these methods finds none; no Java_..._SnailMailApplication_JNIOFInit symbol.
interpretation: The port keeps the declarations but they are unreachable.

claim: check_elf_alignment.py self-test passes: 16 KB-aligned AArch64 .so PASS, 4 KB .so FAIL, stored+aligned APK PASS, deflated APK with armeabi-v7a FAIL, original v7a .so FAIL (ELF32, p_align 0x1000, TEXTREL).
observation: Recorded run 2026-09-27.
interpretation: The checker distinguishes compliant and non-compliant artifacts.

claim: gradle assembleDebug of android/ fails resolving com.android.application 8.13.0 because Google Maven redirects to dl.google.com, which returns 403 in the analysis sandbox.
observation: Failed to get resource: GET. [HTTP HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden: https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/com/android/application/com.android.application.gradle.plugin/8.13.0/...pom]
interpretation: No Android build is possible in this environment; AGP/NDK/SDK versions are unverified pins.
next_step: Build on a machine with Google Maven + SDK/NDK access

claim: Top-level CMake host, ASan/UBSan and AArch64 (qemu) builds pass 4/4 tests with the existing reconstructed/assets module.
observation: ctest: 100% tests passed in all three; AArch64 test binaries are ELF64 aarch64 run via qemu-aarch64.
interpretation: Build infrastructure works end to end.

claim: The port's Java shell and JNI bridge keep the original JNI contract: 18 native declarations (MyOpenFeintDelegate intentionally removed), 26 callbacks with identical descriptors, 18 identical Java_* exports.
observation: PARITY: PASS (recorded 2026-09-27).
interpretation: Reconstructed natives can be dropped in without Java changes.

claim: The only operator new call allocates the cRGame object with size 0x3a6468 bytes.
location: v7a:0x16684-0x16694 (movw/movt r0 then bl _Znwj, bl cRGame::cRGame)
observation: Constant size in r0.
interpretation: Large object with fields at constant offsets (+0x718b4, +0x718fc, +0xbf0, +3028); sizes change if it contains pointers.

claim: 39 __stack_chk_fail call sites and 55 __stack_chk_guard GOT loads (v5: 39/53) show -fstack-protector.
observation: Import census.
interpretation: The port should keep stack protection (NDK default -fstack-protector-strong).

claim: The four entry points JNIAudioInit, JNIDebug, JNIDatUnInit and nativeDone have trivial, fully established bodies: empty, return 0, two calls to the empty wprintf, and calls to the empty appDeinit/importGLDeinit.
observation: Disassembly.
interpretation: Implemented directly in android/app/src/main/cpp/jni_bridge.cpp; all other natives fail loudly.

claim: JNIOFOSave is not empty: it tail-calls OFOSave(), which saves gOFOData to 'of.cfg'.
observation: Disassembly and callsite_args.py.
interpretation: The Java OpenFeint dashboard path still triggers a native save; kept in the port shell.
